title: Weak continuity of Jacobian minors with a continuous compactly supported coefficient (parent step 2)
statement: Let k, Q, r ∈ ℕ, let Ω ⊆ ℝ^k (ℝ^k = Eucl k) be open, ψ : ℝ^k → ℝ Lebesgue-integrable on Ω, g : ℝ^Q → ℝ continuous with compact support, C ≥ 0, and let u_j : ℝ^k → ℝ^Q (j ∈ ℕ) and u₀ : ℝ^k → ℝ^Q all be C-Lipschitz on Ω with u_j → u₀ uniformly on Ω; let a : Fin r → Fin Q and b : Fin r → Fin k. With M_{a,b}(u)(w) := det(EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ u w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1)))_{t,s ∈ Fin r} (Mathlib fderiv, 0 where u is not differentiable; the empty determinant is 1): ∫_Ω ψ(w)·g(u_j(w))·M_{a,b}(u_j)(w) dw → ∫_Ω ψ(w)·g(u₀(w))·M_{a,b}(u₀)(w) dw as j → ∞ (dw = Lebesgue measure).
lean_statement: ∀ (k Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (ψ : Eucl k → ℝ) (g : Eucl Q → ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0) (u : ℕ → Eucl k → Eucl Q) (u₀ : Eucl k → Eucl Q) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → Fin Q) (b : Fin r → Fin k), IsOpen Ω → IntegrableOn ψ Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ j, LipschitzOnWith C (u j) Ω) → LipschitzOnWith C u₀ Ω → TendstoUniformlyOn u u₀ atTop Ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, ψ w * g (u j w) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ (u j) w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, ψ w * g (u₀ w) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ u₀ w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))
